headline.text: L3 depositor problems kept both ML1 and ML4 down most of the shift — ML4 piston faults persisted through *multiple* rebuilds and is still faulting at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 cleared a 3-hour chute modification and came back at 09:02. Sollich 2 fought recurring almond Hapman clogs all day and high decorator temper through end of shift. Sollich 4 chiller lost glycol and stopped depositing at 13:01.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 ran clean after a wrapping quality tweak at 09:00. ML3 and FFS passed all checks with no interruptions.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 piston torque faults on depositors 1 and 4 kept the line down from 05:12 through window close despite pump teardowns, re-washes, and WDS calls. ML1 depositor also faulted on a blown rotary cylinder — maintenance pulling the hopper to rebuild. Truffle line ran after clearing a separator table alignment at startup.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 line stopped for chute modification
resolved.summary: Mess from cereal belt and cross conveyor 1 forced a line stop at 06:24 while maintenance modified and ATP-tested new chutes.
resolved.resolution: Line back up at 09:02 after parts modified, cleaned, ATP tested, and installed (Nathan Topham).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 kitchen and Sucrotherm hard reset
resolved.summary: Kitchen and Sucrotherm required hard reset due to operational problems; caramel production delayed.
resolved.resolution: Reset completed, caramels ready at drain within 1.5 hours; line proceeded to tempering (Katya Farnsworth, 10:21).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 enrober return pump air connection damaged
resolved.summary: Damaged air connection on enrober return pump needed replacement before tempering could start.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance replaced connection; tempering started on both enrober and mini tempering unit at 10:34 (Justin Garner).

resolved.title: Sollich 2 MM6 printer failure
resolved.summary: MM6 printer threw unrepairable error twice and touchscreen not working; no way to rework print if not swapped.
resolved.resolution: Swapped MM6 printer with rework printer at 13:13; will manage rework during accumulation, Videojet scheduled for repair (Justin Garner).

resolved.title: Wrong chocolate code in BOM
resolved.summary: BOM showed 10121 for chocolate when it should have been 10226 on Sollich 3.
resolved.resolution: Updated at 06:58 — "Done, it's been updated!" (Deisy Lopez).

resolved.title: ML2 wrapping quality below target
resolved.summary: Wrapping appearance needed improvement to meet spec.
resolved.resolution: Operator made adjustments at 09:00, better results confirmed at 09:22 (Claudio Tovar).

resolved.title: Truffle line separator table misaligned with cutter
resolved.summary: Separator table misalignment would cause last row to go to trim and product accumulation at startup.
resolved.resolution: Operators aligned the separator table by 05:49 without maintenance assistance (Grey Boscan).

resolved.title: Truffle line M4 and M6 belt chocolate carryover
resolved.summary: M4 belt not running correctly caused chocolate clumping and sensor rejections; later M6 belt had chocolate turning issues.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted belts; at 12:31 "chocolates better aligned now, sensor not rejecting" (TruffleLine FW).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 almond Hapman repeatedly clogging
needs_attention.summary: Almond Hapman clogged at top four times during shift (07:56, 11:49, 12:03, 12:49) requiring maintenance each time.
needs_attention.status: Last clog at 12:49, maintenance called, no clear resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 chiller not keeping tunnels at temp
needs_attention.summary: Chiller unable to maintain correct tunnel temperatures, suspected low glycol; line paused then stopped depositing at 13:01.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance refilling glycol as of 13:01; waiting to restart after refill complete.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 decorator temper running high
needs_attention.summary: Mini tempering unit reading 93°F, decorator buffer 96°F despite setpoint of 90°F; multiple temper readings high throughout shift.
needs_attention.status: At 13:19 lowered mini tempering from 29.5 to 29°C and buffer tank to 87°F; still troubleshooting at window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 MM3 missing part since start of shift
needs_attention.summary: MM3 component missing from start of A-shift; production team unable to locate.
needs_attention.status: Asked Brandon at 12:37 if he knows location, no response by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 almonds past expiration date
needs_attention.summary: Almonds flagged as past expiration; waiting confirmation if date will be extended.
needs_attention.status: Verified with IMS at 13:25, awaiting extension confirmation from Mary Montilla and Charity Young.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 tablets not working due to battery drain
needs_attention.summary: Both tablets on Sollich 4 not functioning; ongoing issue since Friday due to operators not charging between shifts.
needs_attention.status: Ticket open since Friday; shift exchange action created to charge tablets each shift going forward (Erandy, 09:25).

needs_attention.title: ML2 computer stuck in standby mode
needs_attention.summary: ML2 line computer will not come out of standby mode.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:42, no resolution or follow-up posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositors 1 and 4 recurring piston torque faults
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 1 piston fault at 05:12 preventing purge; sliders cleaned, pump system torn down, parts re-washed and ATP'd, reassembled — still faulting with chocolate at 13:20. Depositor 4 showing same fault at 08:22.
needs_attention.status: After reinstalling depositor 1 at 13:20, empty pumping worked but faulted again with chocolate; WDS engaged throughout, line still down at 13:30.

needs_attention.title: ML1 depositor piston fault from blown rotary cylinder
needs_attention.summary: Piston torque fault traced to east rotary air cylinder with large blow-by; attempted fix did not work, now draining depositor to replace cylinder.
needs_attention.status: At 11:55 waiting for hopper removal and glycol shut-off so maintenance can start cylinder rebuild; two rebuild kits on hand.

needs_attention.title: ML4 creme ingredient tank not heating to 110°F
needs_attention.summary: Ingredient tank for creme not reaching target temperature of 110°F.
needs_attention.status: Nelson working on it as of 08:29, no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 scale power cable missing
needs_attention.summary: Power cable for scale cannot be located; production and maintenance unable to find it.
needs_attention.status: Still searching at 10:31, no cable found by window close.
